description: This file defines a serializer for the CultureInfo class, including surrogate conversion and copying mechanisms, within the Orleans.Serialization framework.

classes.name: CultureInfoCodec
classes.description: Serializer class for CultureInfo, handling conversion to and from surrogate representations.

classes.name: CultureInfoSurrogate
classes.description: Data structure used as a surrogate for CultureInfo during serialization.

classes.name: CultureInfoCopier
classes.description: Provides shallow copying capabilities for CultureInfo objects.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a CultureInfoSurrogate to a CultureInfo instance.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a CultureInfo instance to its surrogate form.
